correctness.rationale: At each positive harmonic, the centered energy is an unordered-pair sum of two opposite Fourier characters. Exact circle Haar orthogonality leaves only three-edge configurations using one pair three times (one of the three frequencies equals the other two summed) or three sides of a triangle (all three frequencies equal). These give the all-weight exact third moment with all factors and normalizations; elementary algebra yields exact skewness, and the discrete adjacent difference has exactly one sign transition with no integer tie. The package exact-arithmetic checker directly enumerated all relevant balanced vertex characters on finite test ranges and passed 13,229 assertions. Finite checks corroborate, but the proof establishes all ranges.

value.rationale: The 2020 growing-frequency Sobolev family requires choosing a frequency cutoff for null calibration. The exact all-weight third moment identifies a physically interpretable harmonic-resonance term absent from second moments, and the strict optimum gives a mathematically natural diagnostic cutoff with a sharp linear-in-n scale. The cubic crossover at M of order n squared quantifies a higher-order calibration limitation; no power-optimality, finite-sample size guarantee or normal convergence impossibility is asserted.
